headline: Kimi K3 released as open weights model, enhancing AI inference capabilities on Telnyx.

items.title: Kimi K3 Now Available via Telnyx Inference API
items.summary: Moonshot AI has released the Kimi K3 model as open weights, now accessible through the Telnyx Inference API. This significant release features a 2.8 trillion parameter model optimized for running on GPUs, offering enhanced AI capabilities for developers. The integration into Telnyx provides scalable and high-performance inference services, allowing for advanced model deployment in real-time applications.
items.why_it_matters: Open weight models like Kimi K3 enable developers to implement cutting-edge AI solutions more efficiently and flexibly.

items.title: NVIDIA Ising Enables Fully Automated Quantum Computer Calibration with Enhanced In-Context Learning
items.summary: NVIDIA Ising Calibration is an open-source visualization and calibration tool that automates quantum computer calibration using enhanced in-context learning techniques. This development aims to streamline the calibration process, improving accuracy and reducing time spent on manual adjustments.
